purpose: Runs the real transcription on the owner's own files and on YouTube links, and checks nothing is asked of YouTube and no media is downloaded.
title: Own files work; nothing is fetched from YouTube

testCases.description: for any YouTube link (a video, a short link, a playlist or a channel) Squire's transcription asks nothing of anyone, keeps nothing and says it does not fetch from YouTube, offering Show transcript or the owner's own file
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/video-and-audio.test.js::for any YouTube link (a video's page, a short link, a playlist or a channel), Squire's transcription asks nothing of YouTube or of anyone, downloads and keeps nothing, and says it does not fetch from YouTube, offering the two routes: the transcript pasted from YouTube's own Show transcript, or the owner's own file

testCases.description: the owner's own recording is transcribed on the Mac by the one local engine and kept as a note, nothing sent
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/video-and-audio.test.js::the owner's own recording is transcribed on the Mac by the one local speech engine and the text kept in the owner's folder, the recording left as it was and nothing sent beyond this Mac

testCases.description: the transcription the session loads is asked by the laid floor in both modes, naming video and audio work, never free or refused; a video job is asked as a big job
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/video-and-audio.test.js::the transcription, named by what the session loads, is asked by the safety floor as the session runs it, the question naming video and audio work, never free and never refused, in the default mode and in auto mode; a video job starts through Squire's one job command, which the floor asks for

testCases.description: what the session loads says Squire does not fetch from YouTube and offers the two routes, names no command that reads from YouTube, and the laid core has no captions reader
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/video-and-audio.test.js::what the session loads says Squire does not fetch from YouTube and offers the two routes, the transcript pasted from YouTube's own Show transcript or the owner's own file, and names no command that reads from YouTube; the laid core carries no captions reader

testCases.description: a transcript, a voice note's transcript and kept research are read untrusted: after the owner's profile, a read of one leaves a send refused as one job
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/video-and-audio.test.js::a transcript of the owner's own file, a voice note's transcript and kept research are read as untrusted: in a job that has read the owner's profile, a read of any of them, by Read or by the shell, leaves a send refused as one job

testCases.description: the owner's own recording is transcribed by Squire's own speech helper with no stand-in, built into the Squire home on first use, and a second recording reuses it without a rebuild
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/video-and-audio.test.js::the owner's own recording is transcribed on the Mac by Squire's own speech helper, with no stand-in engine: the helper is built into the Squire home's state on first use and the words kept as a note, and a second recording is transcribed by the helper already built, without building it again

testCases.description: a YouTube link with no scheme, a host in capitals or the mobile host is answered as any YouTube link: nothing asked of anyone, nothing kept, the two routes offered
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/video-and-audio.test.js::YouTube as a class, through the transcription: a YouTube link with no scheme, with its host in capitals or on the mobile host is a YouTube link like any other, so Squire asks nothing of YouTube or of anyone, downloads and keeps nothing, and says it does not fetch from YouTube, offering the transcript pasted from YouTube's own Show transcript or the owner's own file

testCases.description: a session WebFetch of any YouTube address, with a query or none, on any YouTube host in any letter case, is refused by the floor in both modes, naming no captions reader
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/video-and-audio.test.js::YouTube as a class, through the session's own web fetch: a WebFetch of a YouTube address, with a query or with none, on youtube.com, its www, m and music hosts, youtu.be or youtube-nocookie.com, in any letter case, is refused by the safety floor as the session runs it, never free and never asked, in the default mode and in auto mode, the refusal naming no captions reader, and nothing reaches the network

testCases.description: on a Mac whose laid core still holds the captions reader, the command naming it with a YouTube link is refused by the floor in both modes, never asked, naming no captions reader
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/video-and-audio.test.js::the captions reader is never run from the session on a Mac whose laid core still holds core/tools/captions.py: the command naming it with a YouTube link is refused by the safety floor as the session runs it, never asked and never free, in the default mode and in auto mode, its words naming no captions reader, and nothing reaches the network
